messages:
maria-ng: FYI the Cygnus Dedicated incident postmortem is done. I extracted the follow-ups we promised the customer — need owners + ETA so we can close the loop.

maria-ng: High level: root cause was a stale BGP export policy on the on-prem router that intermittently dropped peer prefixes during maintenance windows, which surfaced as tenant isolation. Also found a race in our peering agent that retried with exponential backoff but didn't re-announce routes fast enough.

jonathan: I can own the peering agent fix. Will open a PR with tests and a rollback plan. Target: patch + canary this week (Thu EOD).

alex_k: I'll take the on-prem runbook updates and the customer remediation walkthrough. Need Ryan to confirm the exact router model commands we should recommend.

ryan_ops: Router is Juniper MX480 at Cygnus. Suggested commands to check export policy: ```show configuration policy-options prefix-list cygnus-exports``` and to force reannounce: ```request route reannounce family inet.```. I'll paste a cleaned snippet into the doc.

alex_k: perfect, drop it in the shared doc and I'll add step-by-step.

maria-ng: Action items condensed: 1) peering-agent bugfix (owner: jonathan, ETA: 2067893600[Thu EOD]) 2) runbook + customer walkthrough (owner: alex_k, ETA: 2067897200[Fri EOD]) 3) monitor/add synthetic peering check (owner: tamika, ETA: 2067900800[Mon]) 4) Cygnus postmortem email + timeline (owner: maria-ng, ETA: 2067893000[Wed 6pm])

tamika: I'll add a synthetic probe that validates route presence from both sides and alerts on divergence > 30s. Plan: run in prod, mute for 2 days then escalate. Will create a dashboard tile too.

incident-bot: Created ticket RDW-4312: "Cygnus - peering agent retry race" assigned to jonathan.

jonathan: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/peering-agent/pull/478. Patch fixes the race by resetting backoff on successful handshake and adds a unit test for rapid flaps. Requesting review from @alex_k.

alex_k: Reviewing now. Also, small addition to runbook: after forced reannounce, run `show route protocol bgp table inet.0 | match <cygnus-prefix>` — confirms propagation. I'll add that.

maria-ng: Need a decision on whether we ship the agent patch to Dedicated clusters only first or roll to Hosted as well. Suggest Dedicated-only for 48h canary, because customers with private peering are most sensitive. Thoughts?

ryan_ops: Dedicated-first SGTM. We'll prepare a constrained rollout policy: 10% shard -> 50% -> 100% across Dedicated. Ops will monitor routes and connection flaps during rollout windows.

tamika: I'll wire an automated regression alert tied to the synthetic probe and the existing latency SLO dashboards; if we see repeat isolation patterns (>=2 customers in 7d) auto-open major incident.

maria-ng: Good. Please add the owners + ETAs to the central remediation tracker (Link in #incidents pinned). I'll follow up with Cygnus CS with the timeline after jonathan's canary is green.

jonathan: Canary started at 2067890500. Will post updates here.

(9m later)
jonathan: Canary looks stable on first pass, no flaps for 15m. Promoting to 50% now.

tamika: Added probe and dashboard tile: https://grafana.redwood/d/cygnus-peering. Also wired alert RDW-ALERT-920.

maria-ng: Thanks all — I'll draft the email to Cygnus and attach timeline + mitigation steps. We'll reconvene for the 72h follow-up to validate no recurrence and then close action items. :thumbsup:
